T: Tailored suits. Fine china. Fast food.
D: A street kid is recruited into a secret spy organisation run out of a London tailor's shop.
P: Serve the burgers when Valentine serves Harry fast food on fine china.
S: Eggsy's pub crackling and scotch eggs
Pork crackling and sausage wrapped soft eggs, crumbed and fried, with pickled onions
Pork crackling roasted at 240C until blistered, Scotch eggs boiled 6 minutes and wrapped in sausage meat, crumbed and fried at 170C, and sharp pickled onions on a wooden board.
Cucumber mint cream cheese and smoked salmon dill butter sandwiches, crusts off
Crustless sandwiches of cucumber with cream cheese and mint, and smoked salmon with dill butter, cut into perfectly straight fingers as sharp as a suit.

Vintage cheddar and cayenne shortbread cut into little terrier shapes, baked golden and crisp, served with a sharp pickled onion relish. Human food only. Rub 100g cold butter into 150g plain flour, then add 120g grated vintage cheddar, a pinch of cayenne and salt. Bring together with 1 tbsp cold water, wrap and chill 30 minutes. Roll to 5mm and cut into small dog shapes. Bake at 180C for 12 minutes until golden. Chop 6 pickled onions with a spoon of apple chutney for a relish alongside.
M: Smashed beef patties with American cheese, pickles and mustard ketchup sauce
Chuck mince smashed thin on a smoking griddle, American cheese, pickles, onion and a mustard-ketchup sauce on soft buns, plated on the best china with silver cutlery and linen napkins.
Round table rib roast and Yorkshires
dinner with Arthur and the knights of the agency

Beef rib roast with a black pepper crust, carved pink, with tall Yorkshire puddings, beef dripping roast potatoes, horseradish cream and a rich red wine gravy. Season a 2kg beef rib roast overnight. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 160C to 52C inside, and rest 20 minutes. Parboil 1.2kg potatoes, roast in 3 tbsp dripping at 220C for 50 minutes. Whisk 140g plain flour, 4 eggs and 200ml milk, pour into a smoking hot oiled 12-hole tin and bake at 220C for 20 minutes. Reduce 150ml red wine in the roasting tray, add 300ml stock and simmer for gravy.
W: Crisp meringue, strawberries and whipped cream folded together
Crushed meringue, softly whipped cream and quartered strawberries folded together in glasses, with a drizzle of strawberry purée sweetened with a little sugar.
K: Gin stirred ice cold into a frozen glass with a lemon twist, no vermouth
70ml gin stirred over ice for 10 seconds, strained into a frozen glass, the dry vermouth bottle looked at but never opened. Lemon peel.

dishes.n: Eggsy's pub crackling and scotch eggs
dishes.make_ahead: Crackling and eggs up to 4 hours ahead

steps.text: Score the pork rind, salt it well and roast at 240C until blistered and crisp. Break into pieces.
Boil the eggs for 6 minutes, cool in iced water and peel.
Wrap each egg in sausage mince, dust in flour, dip in beaten egg and crumb in panko.
Fry in the vegetable oil at 170C for 7 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Serve with the crackling, pickled onions and English mustard.

veg.n: Black Prince rice paper crackling and scotch eggs
veg.make_ahead: Scotch eggs up to 4 hours ahead, crackling best fresh

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 6 minutes, cool in iced water and peel.
Squash the sausage filling around each egg, dust in flour, dip in beaten egg and crumb in panko.
Fry at 170C for 7 minutes until golden and hot through.
Cut the rice paper into strips and fry a few at a time in the same oil for a few seconds until puffed. Toss with salt and smoked paprika.
Serve with the crackling, pickled onions and English mustard.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, cover with a damp paper towel

steps.text: Mix the cream cheese with the mint and spread on half the bread.
Top with thin cucumber and a second slice of bread.
Mash the dill into the butter, spread on the remaining bread and layer with salmon.
Trim the crusts and cut into perfectly straight fingers.

dishes.make_ahead: Patties shaped up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Shape the mince into balls ready to smash. Mix the mustard and tomato sauce.
Heat a griddle until smoking. Smash each ball into a thin patty, season and cook for 2 minutes a side, adding cheese at the end.
Toast the buns. Stack two patties per bun with sauce, pickles and onion.
Plate on fine china with silver cutlery and linen napkins.

dishes.make_ahead: Meringue up to 2 days ahead, airtight

steps.text: Whisk the egg whites with most of the sugar to stiff peaks and spoon into rough mounds on a lined tray.
Bake at 100C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven.
Toss the strawberries with the remaining sugar and the lemon juice.
Whip the cream, then fold through the broken meringue and berries.

s.n: Eggsy's pub crackling and scotch eggs
s.note: Pork crackling and sausage wrapped soft eggs, crumbed and fried, with pickled onions
s.how: Score 500g pork rind, salt and roast at 240C until blistered, then break up. Boil 4 eggs for 6 minutes, wrap each in 100g sausage mince, crumb in panko and fry at 170C for 7 minutes. Serve with pickled onions and English mustard.

s.note: Cucumber mint cream cheese and smoked salmon dill butter sandwiches, crusts off
s.how: Spread 8 slices white bread with 150g cream cheese mixed with mint. Fill half with thin cucumber and half with 150g smoked salmon and dill butter. Trim the crusts and cut into perfectly straight fingers.

m.note: Smashed beef patties with American cheese, pickles and mustard ketchup sauce
m.how: Smash 8 thin patties from 800g chuck mince on a smoking griddle and add American cheese. Mix mustard and tomato sauce. Stack two per soft bun with pickles and onion. Plate on fine china with silver cutlery and linen napkins. Manners maketh man.

w.note: Crisp meringue, strawberries and whipped cream folded together
w.how: Whisk 3 egg whites with 180g sugar to stiff peaks and bake in rough mounds at 100C for 90 minutes. Toss 500g sliced strawberries with sugar and lemon. Whip 400ml cream and fold through the broken meringue and berries.

d.note: Gin stirred ice cold into a frozen glass with a lemon twist, no vermouth
d.how: For each drink, stir 70ml gin over ice for 10 seconds and strain into a frozen glass. Look at the dry vermouth bottle, but never open it. Twist a strip of lemon peel over the top.
